caption: The drawing is a rectangular textile-like design primarily in two colors: a dark blue background and white figures and text. It features the following white text: "LYDIA-FELT 1834 BLOOMFIELD EAST FACTORY." The words "LYDIA-FELT" and "1834" are positioned near the top center, with "BLOOMFIELD" below them, and "EAST" oriented vertically along the left side, while "FACTORY" is written vertically on the right side. The top area shows two large, white, stylized hands facing each other horizontally. The lower central part displays a symmetrical decorative motif resembling two birds facing each other above a geometric-patterned planter or pedestal. The background is filled with dots, star-like shapes, and wavy diagonal lines that create a border pattern around the central motifs. The entire composition is framed by a narrow blue rectangle. The artwork appears to imitate the design of a traditional woven coverlet.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
